breakdown.description: Terminal velocity exists because drag balances the net weight; neglecting drag implies continuous acceleration and no finite terminal velocity.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the flawed instruction to neglect drag. Instead, it balanced weight minus buoyancy against aerodynamic drag, using the standard drag equation with C_d = 0.5, rho_air = 1.2 kg/m^3, and all other parameters matching the ground truth. This properly resolves the contradiction in the original prompt.
